name: pi-openai-stt
description: STT provider for any OpenAI-compatible API gateway. Implements the SttProvider contract from pi-telegram-echo; registers with id 'pi-openai-stt'. Talks POST /v1/audio/transcriptions. Env vars: OPENAI_STT_BASE_URL (smart default: OpenAI API if OPENAI_API_KEY is set, else the local fw-openai-sts shim at http://127.0.0.1:8081/v1), OPENAI_API_KEY (optional), OPENAI_STT_MODEL (default whisper-1), PI_TELEGRAM_LANG (default yue).
